verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.turso.tech/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the docs. Individual pages are also served as markdown (e.g. introduction.md), and each one points agents back to the llms.txt index. Many doc pages, including the agent-database and AI-memory guides, are cited at .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
